purpose: A configurable reference preference profile; not universal market truth, calibrated scoring software or a procurement decision.

comparable_reference_price.basis: Matched specification competitor reference price; launch discounts are a separate later strategy.

strong_holiday_or_date_dependency.scope: Not all ordinary seasonal demand; not a permanent category prohibition.

economics.packaging: Use a coherent matched-spec packed dimension/weight tuple; show actual and dimensional weight with the applicable freight and fulfillment rules separately.
economics.fee_fx_and_return_inputs: Retain source, applicable period, units and uncertainty; no invented current rates or zero-filled missing data.

measurement.scoring_subject: Specific physical product form and its genuinely substitutable niche.
measurement.broad_bsr_context: Preserve node, marketplace, timestamp and coverage; do not substitute a broad category denominator for the niche.
measurement.ratings_and_written_reviews: Separate counts and verify tool field meaning.
measurement.normal_start: Verify launch history, old reviews, review-count jumps and drops, parent/child changes and confirmed operator links. Separate Vine, verified-purchase and other review evidence where observable. Vine is not itself evidence of an abnormal start; anomalies are hypotheses, not proof of manipulation. Unresolved cases stay in actual competition analysis but cannot be asserted as proven normal-start exemplars.
measurement.launch_cohorts: Retain entrants, exits, failures and incomplete observation; no population success rate from a top-100 snapshot.
measurement.traffic: Cross-check compatible SellerSprite and SIF evidence with sources and windows retained. Suggested bids are not actual CPC. Modeled visibility and keyword counts are not orders. Ad-heavy visibility alone does not establish failure or unprofitability; actual CVR and ad profitability remain unknown before measurement. Do not average incompatible sources.
measurement.aggregation: Use deduplicated relevant buying entries. Major purchase entries must carry the main suggested-bid pressure; preserve core and longtail views and cheaper smaller-entry opportunities separately. Exact entry-importance estimation and aggregation remain pending real-card calibration. Search-volume research weights are not actual advertising allocation. Do not restore a fixed core/longtail split or equal-weight cheap terms to dilute major-entry pressure.

native_bid_point_and_range.native_point: Use the native suggested point for the main score; equal native points under the same mapping have equal main scores.
native_bid_point_and_range.bounds: Display lower/upper-bound score scenarios separately; they are not actual CPC forecasts or probability bounds.
native_bid_point_and_range.range_width: No automatic penalty merely for a wider range; do not silently rank only by its upper endpoint.
native_bid_point_and_range.interval_only: Retain a supported interval; do not invent a native midpoint.

measurement.bsr_newcomer_entry_evidence: Observe new entrants to a specified BSR top-100 node, their contemporaneous rating counts and entry/retention/exit paths, where historical coverage exists. Keep these observations separate from the comparable niche sales sample. A snapshot cannot establish all launches, timing, success rates or exact sales thresholds.

workflow.future_supplier_leadtime_quality_actual_: Later verification, not fabricated initial inputs.
workflow.unknown_score: Explicitly unavailable or supported interval; never zero, arbitrary midpoint or normalization of only known scores to 100.
workflow.group_variants: Group same direction; score material specification differences separately.

supplier_inquiry.other_channels: Require separately applicable authorization; a stage transition is not permission to message.

development_stage_preference.initial_preference: Existing designs that can plausibly be tested in small batches; public supply listings are evidence leads, not verified delivery commitments.
development_stage_preference.light_differentiation: Optional, source-supported small changes may be researched; do not award points merely for an invented idea.
development_stage_preference.private_molds: Usually consider after market and profit validation, with actual supply capability, MOQ, tooling cost and timing assessed separately; not a permanent exclusion.
development_stage_preference.pain_points: Do not assume our team can solve an industry-wide issue because existing products have low ratings. Feasibility requires later evidence; no new star-rating cutoff.

pending_design: Q31: define the market reference, comparable niche cohort, observation windows, sales grain and contemporaneous rating accumulation; retain separate BSR top-100 newcomer entry/retention/exit evidence. Do not substitute arbitrary pairwise product comparisons for a market judgment. Median sales and lower-quartile rating references remain proposals. Internal 2/2/3/3, joint continuous mapping and aggregation remain unapproved.
Q32: internal rights/public-requirement 3/2 remains unapproved; confirmed specification-conflict handling is already established independently.
All score mapping curves, reference calibration, qualitative rubrics and cross-group duplicate-signal handling.
Missing-data ranking, aggregation and comparison rules without invented certainty.
Initial goods quantity and compatible quote/packaging/freight basis.
Complete end-to-end product design and real-card acceptance.
